stem: On a map scale, 2 inches represents 60 miles. Which graph best shows the relationship between x, the number of inches on the map, and y, the actual distance in miles?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph with a line passing through (0,0) and (3,225)

options.label: B
options.text: Graph with a line passing through (2, 60) and (3, 225)

options.label: C
options.text: Graph with a line passing through (0,0) and (9,225)

options.label: D
options.text: Graph with a line passing through (1, 60) and (3, 225)

visual_elements: Four graphs titled 'Map Scale' each with x-axis labeled 'Number of Inches on Map' from 0 to 9 and y-axis labeled 'Actual Distance (miles)' from 0 to 225.
Graph A: Line from origin (0,0) to about (3, 225).
Graph B: Line starting between 2 and 3 inches at y about 60 to (3, 225).
Graph C: Line from origin (0,0) to (9, 225).
Graph D: Line starting at about 1 inch and 60 miles to (3, 225).
